subject: Fieldbook MAP & handoff play — milestone ledger and owners
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Reynolds <dana@fieldbook.ai>; Mark Fulton <mark@fieldbook.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fieldbook MAP & handoff play — milestone ledger and owners

Hi Dana / Mark —

Great meeting this morning. Per our discussion I drafted a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and a milestone ledger focused on the first 90 days. The attached spreadsheet (Fieldbook_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) is intentionally compact so the Fieldbook team can quickly confirm owners and target dates. Key highlights: 

- Kickoff (technical onboarding): Aug 1 — Redwood lead: Soojin Lee; Fieldbook lead: Dana Reynolds
- Prod intent pilot: Sept 1 — Redwood lead: Marissa Cole; Fieldbook lead: Mark Fulton
- SLA & capacity review checkpoint: Oct 1 — Redwood lead: Ben Carter; Fieldbook: procurement@fieldbook.ai

Open asks for your team: please confirm the Fieldbook owners for the three rows above and any blackout dates in August/September that would affect the pilot. Once we have confirmation I’ll lock dates in the shared doc and route the SOW draft for legal review.

Attachments: Fieldbook_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (worksheet: Milestones / Owners) and SOW-draft-fieldbook-20280720.pdf (redlines enabled).

Thanks — I’ve left a short acceptance checklist at the top of the sheet so we can move quickly.

— Soojin
Soojín Lee (she/her)
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0179

From: Dana Reynolds <dana@fieldbook.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Fulton <mark@fieldbook.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fieldbook MAP & handoff play — milestone ledger and owners

Thanks Soojin — very helpful. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Technical kickoff owner confirmed: Dana Reynolds (I’ll coordinate calendar invites)
- Pilot POC: Mark Fulton will lead; we expect the engineering team to be available week-of Aug 28 for the pilot run (so Sept 1 pilot start looks good)
- Procurement: we need net‑30 and a data processing addendum (DPA) — I copied procurement@fieldbook.ai to loop them in for the Oct 1 checkpoint

One small ask: can we shift the SLA & capacity review from Oct 1 to Oct 8? We have a leadership offsite the first week of October. If that’s okay, please update the ledger.

Also attaching our internal checklist (see inline below) — I’ll forward any procurement docs separately.

Best,
Dana

On Tue, Jul 20, 2028 at 09:12, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great meeting this morning. Per our discussion I drafted a concise mutual action plan...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Reynolds <dana@fieldbook.ai>, Mark Fulton <mark@fieldbook.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fieldbook MAP & handoff play — milestone ledger and owners

Thanks Dana — Oct 8 works from our side. I updated the attached Fieldbook_MAP_v1.2.xlsx with the new date and added a short acceptance criterion per milestone: 

- Technical kickoff (Aug 1) — acceptance: environment provisioned + SSH access validated
- Pilot (Sept 1) — acceptance: 3 sample workflows processed end-to-end with latency < 300ms median
- SLA review (Oct 8) — acceptance: agreed SLOs and cost targets documented in the addendum

Ben — heads-up on capacity planning: Mark flagged that Fieldbook may request a burst during the pilot week (Aug 28–Sept 4). Can you confirm whether we can provision a 2x burst policy on the dedicated pool for that window? If not, we’ll propose a FIFO throttling fallback.

I’ll also prepare a short internal readiness note for the Solutions team and share later today.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Reynolds <dana@fieldbook.ai>, Mark Fulton <mark@fieldbook.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fieldbook MAP & handoff play — milestone ledger and owners

All — I confirmed capacity: we can enable a 2x burst policy for the Aug 28–Sept 4 window on a trial basis. A few operational notes: 

- Cost guardrails: burst will only be enabled once the pilot runs and a post‑pilot usage snapshot is taken (we’ll cap the burst spend to the expected pilot budget in the SOW draft).
- Monitoring: Karthik will set up the per-route dashboards and a token‑level cost alert for the pilot. Karthik, can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?
- Fallback: if we hit capacity headroom limits, we will auto-failover to a compatible quantized model (lower cost) to preserve latency SLOs. This will be documented in the SOW appendix.

I’ll update the SOW-draft-fieldbook-20280720.pdf with the burst terms and the guardrails, then re-share for signatures.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
